_comment: Golden set for the local delegation worker. Every case is scored deterministically: valid JSON, evidence quoted byte-for-byte from the source, confidence in the enum, and required facts present. No LLM judges the output — a judge would import its own bias into a measurement whose whole point is to be reproducible.
